sections.headline: Faster movement.  Closer to winning.
sections.body:
|     |
| --- |
| Rev up your gaming world with 180Hz speed. Ignite your gameplay with a QHD resolution, IPS wide viewing angles, and a jaw-dropping 180Hz refresh rate. |

assets.alt: Side view of a monitor with a gaming archer character on the screen image.

sections.headline: Technology
disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.
*The refresh rate has been upgraded compared to the previous model, 32GP750.

sections.headline: Upgraded speed.  New standard.
sections.body: We have raised UltraGear's speed standard to 180Hz. You can enjoy ultra-clear and smooth images with a 180Hz refresh rate, which loads images 180 times in a second.
disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.

assets.alt: It is a comparison image of a fast-paced game with a low refresh rate and a clear image with a 200Hz (O/C) high refresh rate.

sections.headline: Sharp image  From any angle
sections.body:
Experience the vibrant visuals with a 1ms fast response time, which reduces reverse ghosting and input lag. In addition, the IPS panel allows you to enjoy these stunning images clearly from a wide angle (up to 178 degrees).
DisplayHDR™ 400 with sRGB 99% (Typ.)
disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.
*Select 'Faster Mode' to perform '1ms Response Time'. (Game Adjust → Response Time → Faster Mode).
*The viewing angle of this IPS display is 178 degrees.

assets.alt: With IPS 1ms (GtG), you can experience vivid and clear images from any angle.

sections.headline: Feel true-to-life colour
sections.body: This monitor supports a wide colour gamut, sRGB 99% (Typ.), and VESA DisplayHDR™ 400, reproducing high-fidelity colours for gamers to see the dramatic colours the game developers intended regardless of the battlefield.
disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.

assets.alt: High-quality color robot images with sRGB 99% and DisplayHDR™ 400.

sections.headline: Technology for flawless gaming
sections.body: Enjoy the perfect graphic with reduced tearing, stuttering, or jittering caused by differences in the hardware and software specification by synchronizing through NVIDIA® G-SYNC® Compatible, AMD FreeSync™.
disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.
*The performance of the feature is compared to the models not applied the Sync technology.
*Errors or delays may occur depending on the network connection.

assets.alt: Comparison of fluid gaming image - The left image is tearing, and the Right image is tear-free.

sections.headline: Gamer-centric design
sections.body: Enhance your gaming experience with a 3-side virtually borderless design for an immersive viewing. The adjustable base, which supports tilt, height, and pivot, helps you play games more comfortably.

sections.headline: Pivot
disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.

assets.alt: Three monitor images demonstrating tilt, pivot, and height adjustments.

sections.headline: Award winning gaming GUI
sections.body:
Gamers can use On-Screen Display and OnScreen Control to easily customize the setting from adjusting basic monitor options to registering ‘User Defined Key’ that user can set the shortcut. | | | --- | | \*To download the latest OnScreen Control software, visit LG.COM.
\*The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use. |

sections.headline: Dynamic Action Sync
sections.body: Reducing input lag with Dynamic Action Sync, gamers can catch critical moments in real-time and respond quickly.

assets.alt: Graphical User Interface (GUI) image of UltraGear monitor.
Comparison of Dynamic Action Sync - The left image does not support DAS, and the Right image does support DAS.

sections.headline: Black Stabilizer
sections.body: Black Stabilizer helps gamers to detect snipers lurking in the darkest corners and swiftly navigate flash explosions.

assets.alt: Comparison of Black Stabilizer - The left image is the Black Stabilizer 'off,' and the Right image is the Black Stabilizer 'on'

sections.headline: Crosshair
sections.body: The target point is fixed in the center to enhance shooting accuracy.

assets.alt: Comparison of Crosshair - The left image is the Crosshair 'off,' and the Right image is the Crosshair 'on'

sections.headline: FPS Counter
sections.body:
The FPS Counter will let you see how well everything is loading. Whether you're editing, playing games, or watching a movie, every frame matters, and with the FPS Counter, you'll have real-time data.

disclaimers: *The images simulated to enhance feature understanding. It may differ from actual use.
*The Crosshair feature is unavailable while the FPS Counter is activated.
*FPS Counter may display the value that exceeds the monitor’s maximum refresh rate.
*FPS (Frame Per Second) Counter: Measurement of frames per second.
